title: Port ModernBERT-DNA 37M masked DNA encoder with pinned Python parity
description:
Add a compact DNA-only foundation model, starting with RaphaelMourad/ModernBERT-DNA-v1-37M-hg38 (36783616 stored parameters, first checkpoint upload March 2 2025). Human hg38 training, DNA BPE, bidirectional MLM/embeddings, context 8192 tokens; not a joint DNA/protein model, autoregressive generator, or a 10kb-token context. A 117M sibling can follow after verifying reuse. Official weights and Transformers inference implementation declare Apache-2.0. Linked tutorial/training repository has no top-level license; do not copy that code assuming the weights license covers it.
Sources: https://huggingface.co/RaphaelMourad/ModernBERT-DNA-v1-37M-hg38/tree/f0898c773bc52e9ab9d0251a7d8990b41feb5dd7 ; https://huggingface.co/RaphaelMourad/ModernBERT-DNA-v1-117M-hg38/tree/a4517e5cca659daf36e4feff2b53dfd5156e6cfa ; https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/a22a4378d97d06b7a1d9abad6e0086d30fdea199/src/transformers/models/modernbert/modeling_modernbert.py .
design: Use config/source over inconsistent model-card prose: ModernBertForMaskedLM, 8 layers, hidden 768, 8 heads, intermediate 768, vocabulary 4096. Evaluate existing Candle ModernBERT support before writing a new encoder. Preserve global attention every third layer, local window 128 (plus/minus64), differing global/local RoPE bases and gated GELU FFN. Load tokenizer.json via Rust tokenizers with exact casing, CLS/SEP, special masking and BPE offsets. DNA BPE tokens are not one base per token: define token/base alignment without weakening the existing protein per-residue embedding contract. Keep scope inference and documented DNA masking/embedding example, not retraining or unsupported biological benchmark claims.
acceptance_criteria: Pin model/source/tokenizer revisions and provenance; use the licensed inference implementation. Exact tokenizer IDs, specials and base offsets match Python for asymmetric DNA including ambiguous symbols. Compare final hidden states, full MLM logits and selected intermediate outputs against committed pinned Python fixtures. Include lengths on both sides of the local attention window, positions testing local/global RoPE, padding and unequal-length batches so a full-attention-only substitute fails. Test 8192-token boundary and explicit overlength policy. Establish justified CPU F32 numeric tolerances, BF16-checkpoint loading, measured latency/memory and public DNA example. Missing reference fixtures must not silently skip. Do not label DNA-only input as mixed-modality or generic PLM residue alignment.
notes:
Verified the installed candle-transformers 0.11.0 already contains models/modernbert.rs, ModernBertForMaskedLM, distinct local/global rotary embeddings and layer-specific local masks. This makes it a promising reuse-first port; checkpoint compatibility and numerical parity remain untested.
2026-11-03: attempted, not started in code. huggingface.co API/small files reachable from cloud sessions, but LFS weight downloads redirect to us.aws.cdn.hf.co (also cas-bridge.xethub.hf.co, cdn-lfs.hf.co) which the cloud environment's network policy blocks (403). Pinned rev f0898c77 metadata verified: config.json sha256 4a6e15ff..., tokenizer.json sha256 5d178e8c..., model.safetensors LFS oid 4e88b5f3045e22d55690a9431e1792be1573adca9b64a4d9df021f383b32dbad (73572576 bytes, BF16). Config: all biases false except decoder_bias=true, hidden_activation=gelu (exact), classifier_activation=gelu, global_rope_theta=160000, local_rope_theta=10000, local_attention=128, global_attn_every_n_layers=3, pad=3 cls=1 sep=2 mask=4. candle-transformers 0.11.1 modernbert.rs matches these (layer-0 attn_norm via .ok(), local window |i-j|<=64, rope half-split, GeGLU gelu_erf, tied decoder + decoder.bias) BUT builds rotary cos/sin in the model dtype (BF16 would round positions) and silently drops attn_norm on any layer whose weights are missing. Tokenizer: BPE, Whitespace pre-tokenizer, no normalizer, TemplateProcessing [CLS] A [SEP]. Blocked until HF CDN hosts are allowed.

title: Evaluate and port gLM2 150M mixed DNA/protein masked-language encoder with parity
description:
Expand Ferritin beyond protein-only models using TattaBio gLM2. It represents genomic contigs with translated coding sequences as uppercase amino acids and intergenic DNA as lowercase nucleotides, with strand markers. Official nominal 150M and 650M checkpoints; the small checkpoint safetensors metadata reports 152457600 F32 parameters. Context 4096 tokens, 37-token vocabulary, 30 layers, width 640, 10 heads. Code and checkpoint declare Apache-2.0. Released checkpoint created September 2024; associated OMG paper ICLR 2025. This is bidirectional masked modeling, not a native autoregressive generator or a raw-genome gene annotator.
Sources: https://github.com/TattaBio/gLM2/tree/ee8cea27f842dd16f2977626cbe5c1c8c617f4fe ; https://huggingface.co/tattabio/gLM2_150M/tree/93c88529115476b27bdd85da14311779114a8a64 ; https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/file/dbb40375daa3c39f1c098b12608aed12-Paper-Conference.pdf .
design: New checked architecture, not an ESM2 registry alias: noncausal rotary attention, fused bias-free QKV, pre-RMSNorm residual blocks, SwiGLU rounded to 256, norm epsilon 1e-5, and separate RMSNorm/projection LM head. Inspect possible AMPLIFY/Candle primitive reuse without assuming identical block/checkpoint layout. Preserve the shipped tokenizer.json exactly (empty BPE merges, no normalizer or postprocessor): A and a have different modalities; <+>, <->, <mask>, <sep> are tokens, not residue text. Define token/element alignment explicitly for mixed inputs and keep protein-only PlmRunner residue semantics intact; use the smallest consumer-specific API rather than speculative cross-modality framework changes. Existing reference expects DNA lowercase with <+> prefix and externally translated CDS. Larger follow-on: Minerva-MLM (2026, gLM2-650M-derived, 4k/8k, extra interaction heads) is interesting but not small and not automatically covered by gLM2 parity.
acceptance_criteria: Record pinned sources, checkpoint hash and licenses; prototype CPU reference tokenization/inference before selecting reuse boundary. Public inference supports DNA-only, protein-only and mixed contig tokens without case normalization. Exact token-ID fixtures distinguish A/a, strand markers, masks, separators and unknown nucleotide handling; boundary tests cover 4096-token limit with clear truncation/rejection behavior. Compare embeddings, intermediate block outputs and all-vocabulary MLM logits with pinned Python on asymmetric mixed sequences, padding/unequal batches and both relevant strand orientations. Numeric tolerances and memory/runtime measured, not guessed. Demonstrate contextual DNA/protein embeddings or mask predictions; do not advertise full-genome translation, validated downstream biology, AR generation or Minerva interaction-head support from this port alone.
notes: 2026-11-03: not started. Weights are on HF; cloud sessions currently get 403 on the HF LFS CDN (us.aws.cdn.hf.co, cas-bridge.xethub.hf.co, cdn-lfs.hf.co) while huggingface.co metadata works, so neither the Python reference nor the Rust port can load the checkpoint there. Needs those hosts allowed in the cloud environment, or a local session.

title: Port AbLang2 45M paired-antibody encoder and masked-residue scoring with parity
description:
Add the compact AbLang2 antibody specialist to ferritin-plms: paired heavy/light-chain representations, masked residue restoration and likelihood/mutation scoring. This is an antibody variable-domain model, not a general de novo peptide generator. Approximately 45M parameters; paper published October 2024, but released weights date to November 2023. Official code is BSD-3-Clause; Zenodo weights are BSD-3-Clause-Clear, not the AGPL license of an unrelated wrapper.
Sources: https://github.com/oxpig/AbLang2/tree/586af3083c32b5fb2f0a1c855f2ad4f1cad15ec3 ; https://zenodo.org/records/10185169 ; https://academic.oup.com/bioinformatics/article/40/11/btae618/7845256 .
design: Inspect official config/weights, paired-chain tokenizer and output head; implement the exact encoder attention scaling, rotary convention, linear biases, activation and layer norm settings. Preserve heavy/light ordering, chain separator/masking and output-to-residue alignment. Use existing weight loader/registry and embedding/logit contracts where valid; do not silently flatten chain separators into residues or claim a biological scoring task from embeddings alone.
acceptance_criteria: Pin official code, weight archive checksum and token alphabet; document both licenses. Verify token IDs, per-residue embeddings and full masked-LM logits against committed official-Python fixtures for paired heavy/light chains, supported single-chain inputs, masking and unequal-length padded batches. Check boundary/chain order and ambiguity behavior independently. CPU F32 numerical tolerances justified; fixture absence fails rather than skips. Public example demonstrates masked residue ranking or scoring with correctly aligned residues. Keep conformance/registry metadata honest about supported tasks and verified checkpoint.
close_reason: Ported and parity-verified in commit 0d6ed7c on claude/focused-fermat-8fte3n. Official oxpig/AbLang2 @586af308 run on Zenodo 10185169 (archive sha256 7acb23b8..., model.pt sha256 56d6f078...) via scripts/generate_ablang2_fixtures.py -> tests/fixtures/ablang2_parity.safetensors (1.06 MB). 12 tests in test_plm_ablang2.rs: ids, roles, hidden (3.9e-6), layers 0/1/12, logits for paired/heavy-only/light-only/masked/unknown (<=3.4e-5), padded unequal batch (4.5e-5) + batch==single, PLL/confidence (3e-7), restore, tied head, determinism, chain-adapter row selection. Fixture absence errors (ParityFixture::load), not skips. Registry row Verified, Family::AbLang2, Zenodo host added to loader with sha256-checked atomic cache. Example: cargo run --example ablang2. Not ported: ANARCI alignment (align=True), TCRLang.

title: Port DPLM-2 150M sequence/structure token inference with pinned Python parity
description:
Add the compact multimodal DPLM-2 checkpoint to ferritin-plms. It is not the existing ESM-2-schema DPLM-650M row: DPLM-2 adds joint sequence/structure tokens and diffusion sampling. Nominal 150M refers to the backbone, not the complete structure tokenizer/decoder pipeline. Official checkpoint uploaded May 2025; original paper October 2024. Code, checkpoint and separate structure tokenizer declare Apache-2.0.
Sources: https://github.com/bytedance/dplm/tree/8a2e15e53416b4536f03f79ad1f6f6a9cbd5e19d ; https://huggingface.co/airkingbd/dplm2_150m/tree/3451d984d06497f835ed49634bd68c9dfb54d730 ; https://huggingface.co/airkingbd/struct_tokenizer ; https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.13782 .
design: First inspect the pinned config, checkpoint keys and upstream diffusion schedule; reuse existing ESM/Candle primitives only where contracts actually match. Preserve the amino-acid vocabulary and 8192 structure codes plus structural specials. Implement token inference and deterministic diffusion trajectories with controlled masks/random draws. Scope first delivery to sequence/structure token inference and sampling with precomputed structure tokens. Track the separate structure encoder/decoder explicitly before promising coordinates or PDB generation; report its parameter/memory cost separately. Do not add a broad generative-model abstraction solely for this port.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned upstream code, checkpoint, tokenizer and hashes/license provenance recorded. Public loading/inference path produces correct amino-acid and structure-token logits against committed Python reference fixtures, not only shapes. Fixtures cover sequence-only, structure-conditioned and joint masked inputs, token boundaries, padding and unequal-length batches. Sampling uses injected identical draws/schedules or compares stage distributions rather than assuming matching RNG seeds. CPU F32 errors and justified tolerances reported; full-generation claims require an executed decoder check. Registry/conformance integration accurately describes supported capabilities and verified checkpoints; no missing-fixture skip presented as success.
notes: 2026-11-03: not started. Weights are on HF; cloud sessions currently get 403 on the HF LFS CDN (us.aws.cdn.hf.co, cas-bridge.xethub.hf.co, cdn-lfs.hf.co) while huggingface.co metadata works, so neither the Python reference nor the Rust port can load the checkpoint there. Needs those hosts allowed in the cloud environment, or a local session.

title: Register TCRLang-paired (AbLang2 architecture, Zenodo 11208211) with its own parity fixture
description: TCRLang-paired reuses the AbLang2 architecture with TCR weights (zenodo.org/records/11208211, tcrlang-weights.tar.gz). ferritin-sxg's runner/loader should load it given its hparams.json; needs archive sha256 pin, a registry row, and a fixture from the same generator with TCR alpha/beta inputs. Check hparams (vocab/special ids) match before assuming reuse.
close_reason: Done in commit on claude/focused-fermat-8fte3n (2026-11-05). tcrlang-paired registered, Verified against official oxpig/AbLang2 @586af308 on Zenodo 11208211 (archive sha256 027e32a0..., model.pt sha256 5f93dcf7...); fixture tcrlang_parity (JM22, TRB first). Same 12 checks as AbLang2, worst logits 3.8e-5. from_dir now takes the model and checks its sha256.

title: AbLang2: port ANARCI-aligned modes (align=True) or document the gap in the API
description: ferritin-sxg ported AbLang2's unaligned paths only. Upstream's align=True (restore with spread sequences, aligned rescoding/likelihood) shells out to ANARCI IMGT numbering, which has no Rust equivalent in ferritin. Decide: port numbering, accept externally numbered input, or keep unsupported with an explicit error. Restore without alignment is verified; aligned restore is what upstream recommends for N-terminal truncations.
